{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: replace '999,999.99' with NaN and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].replace('999,999.99', pd.NA)
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check the first few rows after cleaning
df[['revenue']].head()"}
